 Discuss the Trail Blazers vs. Thunder Rematch Here!
 Talk Portland versus OKC as the game unfolds!
 by Dave Deckard Nov 12, 2026, 2:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The Portland Trail Blazers and Oklahoma City Thunder are suiting up for Round 2 of their Western Conference battle tonight at the Moda Center. Portland won the first contest 123-103. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and friends will be back at 7:00 PM, Pacific to try and earn the split. Will they get it or will Portland prevail? Either way, this is your thread to discuss the action with your friends and neighbors!
 Here’s the basic info you need for the game:
 Portland Trail Blazers (7-3) vs. Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3) - Wednesday, November 11th - 7:00pm Pacific 
 How to watch via antenna or cable: See your options for the Rip City Television Network .
 How to watch via streaming: BlazerVision in Oregon and Washington; League Pass everywhere else
 How to listen: Trail Blazers Audio Network 
 Trail Blazers Injuries: Vit Krejci, Ja Morant, Shaedon Sharpe (out)
 Thunder Injuries: Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace, Thomas Sorber, Nikola Topic, Jaylin Williams (Out).
 Also please remember our GameDay Thread rules:
 Blazer’s Edge is a non-profanity site. Yes, even though referees and the L*kers exist. 
 Stay on topic in Game Day threads. There are tons of comments each evening. Adding off-topic ones here just gets confusing. 
 No trolling, please. This includes ad hominem arguments, extreme language about the game or either team, and/or repeated “spammed” comments stating the same point, among other things. Keep conversation respectful and civil. This remains true for all parties if opposing fans visit the thread. 
 No offensive language (racist, sexist, etc.) is ever allowed at Blazer’s Edge. Comments attacking or disparaging people for their inherent characteristics may (and probably will) result in immediate ejection from the site. 
 Please avoid making comparisons, analogies, etc. to hot-button issues like politics, religion, and the like. We’re here to talk basketball, at least for the duration of the game. 
 Enjoy the action! See you after the game with our instant recap and analysis!
